verdict.rationale: Asana's first-party material says users can turn team expertise into custom AI Teammates, configure each agent's identity, scoped permissions, approved actions and spend limits from an admin console, and rely on shared memory. An API endpoint also lists the AI Teammates configured in a workspace, and AI Studio offers no-code AI automations. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the agent-building and configuration workflow (instructions, tools, triggers), and independent or hands-on corroboration that custom agents can be built as claimed.
